meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: Hides ads, Gaana's app download strips and the Gaana Plus trial banner on Gaana, a media site
meta.notes:
**Checked 2026-11-13**, logged out, headless Chromium on https://gaana.com/ (home page only) with an iPhone UA at 390x844 and a desktop UA at 1440x900. Both were served the same React page. Counts below are `querySelectorAll` on that DOM.

- **App download strip** (LIVE 1 on the phone, 0 on the desktop): `section.appAdTopBox`, the "Download Gaana App" strip above the header.
- **Bottom app panel** (LIVE 1 on each): `div.bottomStickyPanel`, the fixed app-download slider at the foot of the page; on the desktop it is rendered but has a height of 0.
- **Gaana Plus trial banner** (LIVE 1 on each): `div.gaanaRenewBanner`, the banner whose link is labelled "30 Days Trial Plan".
- **Ad slots** (LIVE 3 on the phone, 4 on the desktop): the generic ad rule already covers them. The three slots are `div[id^="MirchiPlus_"]`, which carry `data-google-query-id`; the desktop page adds one `iframe[src*="doubleclick.net"]`.
- **Cookie banners**: no consent dialog was served to the research session, 0 matches for every selector in the generic rule, so that rule stays best effort only.
- **Smart App Banner**: none was served, 0 matches.

The fixtures `real.html` and `desktop-real.html` are sanitised excerpts of the two captures (text, images and remote resources stripped, `data-keep` on the header). **Not verified:** only the home page was opened. There is no account here, so album, playlist and player pages, and every logged-in view, were not reached; the app's own pages may use different markup.
